summary: Fluent, Inc., an advertising services company traded on Nasdaq under FLNT, filed an 8-K reporting that on September 30, 2026 it and wholly-owned subsidiaries Fluent, LLC, Fluent Media Labs, LLC and AdParlor, LLC amended their Accounts Receivable Finance Agreement with CSNK Working Capital Finance Corp. d/b/a Bay View Funding, raising the maximum aggregate advance from $30 million to $35 million. Advances remain secured by substantially all company assets and must be repaid per agreement terms. This is an ordinary credit-facility upsize under Items 1.01/2.03, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor or board recommendation apply. Watch liquidity and borrowing-base headroom.
